title: Run a tiny bytecode interpreter
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge learning assembly
prerequisites: Bounded byte decoding and full-width addresses
Saved registers and native stack frames
Checked signed-word arithmetic and branch control
learningObjectives: Distinguish guest execution from native interpretation
Decode variable-length records and instruction boundaries
Apply structural and branch-validation priority before execution
Preserve semantic stack state on faults
Count retirement and budget at precise boundaries
Measure complete work while preserving fresh-call behavior

progression.localImplementation: Native prose, region replacements and CLI grading; interactive trainer and screenshot runner pending
